answer:
The bug is fixed and `bb-test` passes (2 tests).

In `timeparse/duration.py`, the loop assigned `total = ...` on each match, so only the last unit survived. Changing it to `total += ...` makes the units add up, so `"1h30m"` now returns 5400 and `"1h2m3s"` returns 3723. I also added `test_units_add_up` in `tests/test_duration.py` to cover both cases from the issue.
